_doc: The gatekeeper's built-in policy (docs/design/phone-gatekeeper.md, Phase 1). One file, read by the Android app (GateRules.kt) and by the Python reference implementation the tests use (tests/gatekeeper_ref.py). Regexes use only syntax Java and Python share; a leading (?i) is the only inline flag. Word lists are matched on whole normalized words (NFKD, diacritics stripped, lower-cased).

uninstall._doc: The package installer's uninstall confirmation is a delete-kind step (tap level) for the app it names; installing stays refused. The target is the installed app whose label the dialog shows; a blocked app or OpenMob is refused; an app the phone can't name asks.

permission_dialog._doc: Android runtime permission dialogs. Kinds from the dialog's message; buttons by resource id, else text (English, Spanish, German). The task's own app may answer by the owner's settings without a prompt; another app's request asks; never 'Allow all the time'. Android 14+ hides the dialog from accessibility: the phone reads it with on-device OCR (ocr).

ocr._doc: The phone's own screenshot, read with ML Kit (bundled Latin model, offline): text lines below min_conf are dropped; the title starts with title_start and runs to its '?'; a button is a line that reads exactly as a button text, its box padded by pad px. Anything else in the dialog, tapped, asks.
